content.value: Consider the following binary tree representation of a max heap.
i) Give the array representation of the heap.
ii) Delete the maximum key. Give the resulting heap, circling any entries from (i) that changed.
iii) Insert the key Q into the original binary heap, circling any entries from (i) that changed.
